FIELD MANUAL

LIVE CREW CONTROLS

W A S D move · Shift sprint · Mouse aim (click game to lock camera) · Left mouse fire on Planet B · E interact · Enter chat · Esc release cursor.

BUILD: E picks up your assigned part on its rack. R rotates, E mounts at the outline. Hold LMB or E near each glowing fastener. B points to your next objective. F1–F4 or crew buttons switch into an open specialist seat. V changes camera.

CHECKS: Stow four supply cases at the aft ring. Pilot tests engines; Engineer tests pressure and power. Use the mouse wheel to calibrate, then hold E. Pilot chooses a valid route.

FLIGHT: Pilot uses WASD to avoid debris. Engineer walks to power, cooling and atmosphere consoles and holds E. Gunner fires at debris and rival ships. Raider presses X to spacewalk, Space / Ctrl to move vertically, and E to remove or repair damaged exterior plates. Return to the airlock and press X to board. Q / middle mouse / F activate crew abilities.

PLANET B: 1–3 select weapons, R reloads, middle mouse throws a grenade, C crouches and Space jumps. Raider aligns with a sample and holds E through scan, stabilization and extraction. Engineer support speeds work. E loads at the marked aft cargo ring. G drops. Pilot presses N to return. Deliver at the receiving station on Planet A; then end the mission.
